fact: The labour force survey moved from the ENE to the EMO, drawn on a sampling frame built from RGPH 2024, with a dual ENE/EMO collection in 2025 and provisional back-cast series published in 2026.
title: Principaux indicateurs trimestriels rétropolés provisoires du marché de travail selon la méthodologie EMO. Période de 2017 à 2025
